rv.q: The show is entertaining and serious. The sketches don't always make people laugh, but they make their point about a system of suffering that shouldn't exist.
Furious in its politics, generous in its spirit, and unexpectedly tender in its conclusion, STUFFED makes a compelling case for theatre that does not stop at telling us what is wrong with the world.
Both radical and relevant, STUFFED both entertains and provides plenty of food for thought.
Ugly Bucket masterfully uses fast-paced clowning and high-energy physical theatre to translate these heavy, verbatim testimonies into a visceral, visually arresting experience.

cn.t: Critics praise this urgent physical theatre piece tackling UK food insecurity, with audiences sharing a meal before the show. The innovative structure and timely subject matter resonate strongly, earning widespread acclaim.
